'''Predict Natural Disaster''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] in the Sense family of abilities. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to sense changes in meteorological and geological conditions to predict disasters such as [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]], [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity, floods, and storms among others.

The degree to which the Jedi could predict the disaster depended on several factors, including the amount of time they has spent in the locality, familiarity with topography and weather patterns, and the severity of the disaster.
